description: Checks a job post against pay transparency laws before it is published. Give every location the job is based in or could be done from, whether it can be done remotely, the employer headcount and the posting date. Returns each law that applies (or may apply, with the reason), a merged checklist of what the post must include (for example a good-faith minimum and maximum pay range and a description of benefits), salary history question bans, penalties and the official source and citation per law. Covers US states and cities, Canadian provinces and the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970 country by country, including countries that have not transposed it yet. Free.

date.description: Posting date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. Future dates include laws already enacted with a later start.

employer_employees.description: Total employees. Several laws only cover employers above a size. Optional.

locations.description: Where the job is based or could be done. Each item is a string like "Denver, CO", "New York City", "Ontario, Canada", "Germany", or an object {country, state, city}.

remote.description: True if the job can be done remotely. Many US laws then apply to remote jobs that could be done in their state.

remote_scope.description: If remote, where from: "US", "EU", "Canada" or "anywhere". Default: the countries of the locations given.

name: check_job_post

description: Lists coverage (laws by country and status), the date the data was last checked, and related Nero Labs Rules servers. Free.
name: list_capabilities

description: Lists pay transparency laws with status (in force, enacted not yet in force, pending, EU transposition overdue), start date, who is covered and what a posting must include. Filter by country ("US", "CA", "EU" or an EU country name) and status. Free.

country.description: Optional: "US", "CA", "EU", or a country name such as "Germany".

name: list_pay_transparency_laws

description: Lists pay transparency laws and amendments starting in a date window, soonest first, so a recruiter or HR agent can prepare. Free.
name: list_upcoming_pay_transparency_changes
